name: git-release
description: Prepare focused, reviewable commits and releases for the project.

# Git and release

Keep changes scoped, reproducible, and easy to review.

- Inspect status and the diff before and after edits; never overwrite unrelated worktree changes.
- Keep generated directories such as `.vite` out of commits unless the repository explicitly tracks them.
- Run the smallest relevant checks before committing, then record the commands and outcomes.
- Update versioning or release documentation only when the project’s existing workflow requires it.
- Use clear imperative commit messages and include the required Copilot co-author trailer when creating commits.
